title: Palm Sugar Japanese Noodle Dessert
description: A simple dessert made with Japanese noodles, melted palm sugar, and a hint of oozy goodness.

ingredients.name: oozy
ingredients.notes: a drizzle of oozy goodness for garnish

instructions: Combine Japanese noodles and water in a saucepan and cook until the noodles are soft.
Drain the noodles and set aside.
In a separate saucepan, melt the palm sugar over low heat.
Add the melted sugar to the noodles and toss until the noodles are well coated.
Drizzle a small amount of oozy goodness over the top of the noodles.
